claim_policy.public_summary: Five accepted Ibex optimization artifacts, including two whole-core results and three module-level results.

status_definitions.accepted_whole_core_result: Accepted whole-core result: an optimization that stayed beneficial after integration into the whole processor and passed the recorded area, timing, activity, formal-equivalence, and replay checks.
status_definitions.accepted_module_artifact: Accepted module-level result: an optimization with evidence for one named RTL module; it is not a whole-core processor claim.
status_definitions.accepted_module_local_artifact: Accepted module-level result: an optimization with evidence for one named RTL module and its local proof obligations; it is not a whole-core processor claim.
status_definitions.exploratory_lead: Exploratory lead: a baseline, reconnaissance result, or early candidate that has not yet passed the full evidence path and is not an optimization claim.
status_definitions.receipt: Machine-readable evidence file or hosted run linked from a row; it is the starting point for independently checking the claim.
status_definitions.rejected_tradeoff: Rejected tradeoff: a candidate with at least one favorable checked axis, such as area or timing, that is not accepted because another required axis regressed.

metric_definitions.area: Synthesis size estimate; lower is usually better.
metric_definitions.wns: Worst negative slack, a timing metric where improvement means more timing margin.
metric_definitions.data_arrival_max_delay: Timing measurements where lower delay or better margin is better.
metric_definitions.liberty_cells: Cells counted after mapping to a standard-cell library.
metric_definitions.toggle: Switching-activity count used as a power proxy; flat means the checked count did not increase.
metric_definitions.saif: Switching-activity file format used for the toggle check.
metric_definitions.yosys_equivalence: Formal check that the optimized RTL preserves original behavior for the checked scope.
metric_definitions.rtl: Register-transfer-level hardware source code, usually Verilog or SystemVerilog.
metric_definitions.miter: Formal equivalence check that connects original and changed designs and proves relevant outputs match.
metric_definitions.bad_mutant: Intentionally wrong version used to prove a check fails when behavior changes.
metric_definitions.oss_fv: Hosted open-source formal-verification workflow used by the Ibex evidence runs.
metric_definitions.cold_replay: Receipt rerun from a fresh checkout or fresh environment instead of warm local state.
metric_definitions.selected_flow: Target-specific synthesis/timing flow used before spending time on deeper proof or activity checks.
metric_definitions.timing_groups: Path classes used in selected-flow timing reports: in2out is input-to-output, in2reg is input-to-register, reg2out is register-to-output, and reg2reg is register-to-register. Lower slack is worse.
metric_definitions.generic_yosys_no_abc: Early synthesis screens that can identify leads but are not enough by themselves for an accepted optimization claim.
metric_definitions.detector: Automated search rule that looks for a possible optimization.
metric_definitions.preflight: Setup work before a usable baseline exists.
metric_definitions.ppa: Area, timing, and power-style evidence; this repo spells out the individual checks whenever a row claims impact.
metric_definitions.activity: Switching activity measured from a simulation trace; this repository uses it as a power proxy and rejects candidates that increase it unless a later sanctioned convention says otherwise.

rejected_tradeoffs.summary: Area improved 3365.728000 -> 3299.414400 (-1.9702%) and all selected-flow timing groups improved in the consuming parent context; Yosys equivalence proved for PULP_SECURE=0 and PULP_SECURE=1, and the negative control failed as expected. Rejected because exercised toggle activity increased 338551 -> 359771 (+6.267889%).

Area improved 5950.707200 -> 5512.787200 (-7.359125%) in the LSU EX-stage selected-flow parent context, and reg2out/reg2reg timing improved. Rejected because in2out, in2reg, and overall timing slack regressed; equivalence, activity, and replay were not run after the timing failure.

Area improved 5950.707200 -> 5933.190400 (-0.294365%) in the LSU EX-stage selected-flow parent context. Rejected because all recorded timing groups regressed, including in2out -0.8415 -> -1.7815 and overall -0.8415 -> -1.7815; equivalence, activity, and replay were not run after the timing failure.

The aligner module itself improved area and timing, and the IF-stage parent context reduced area 18228.732800 -> 18203.708800 (-0.137278%). Rejected because parent in2out timing regressed 1.1039 -> 0.9067; equivalence, activity, and replay were not run after the timing failure.

The enclosing IF-stage selected-flow run reduced area 18228.732800 -> 18204.960000 (-0.130414%) and improved all five timing groups; activity was flat 21739 -> 21739 and a source-local predicate proof closed with three biting negatives. Rejected because the reusable prefetch-buffer scope regressed in2out, in2reg, overall, and reg2reg timing, so the standalone prefetch-buffer reuse caveat blocks promotion.

The MULH slice selected-flow run improved area 13207.667200 -> 13172.633600 (-0.265252%) and all five timing groups, and the EX-stage multiplier parent context reduced area 77151.494400 -> 76960.060800 (-0.248127%). Rejected because parent in2reg, reg2out, and reg2reg timing regressed; equivalence, activity, and replay were not run after the timing failure.

The CSR module selected-flow run improved area 24835.068800 -> 24664.905600 (-0.685160%), the module activity proxy improved 216581 -> 211003, and module Yosys equivalence closed with 886/886 cells. Rejected because the selected EX-stage CSR parent context increased area 25329.292800 -> 25523.228800 (+0.765659%) and regressed reg2reg timing -1.9486 -> -2.0358.

The ALU selected-flow run improved area 29440.736000 -> 28974.038400 (-1.585210%) and improved reg2out/reg2reg timing. Rejected because input timing regressed hard: in2out -16.5915 -> -21.0372, in2reg -13.9355 -> -18.6742, and overall -16.5915 -> -21.0372. The row overlaps prior ALU packets and is non-additive.

The popcount rewrite improved module area 934.646400 -> 932.144000 (-0.267738%) and ALU-parent area 29841.120000 -> 29674.710400 (-0.557652%), closed the module output SAT check with a biting bad-nibble control, and stayed activity-neutral in the ALU-parent proxy. Rejected because the enclosing EX-stage ALU context regressed reg2out timing -1.2725 -> -1.8126; there is no EX-stage proof/activity receipt or customer-impact claim.

The compressed-decoder module selected-flow run improved area 1289.987200 -> 1278.726400 (-0.872939%). Rejected because the consuming IF-stage parent context increased area 18228.732800 -> 18267.520000 (+0.212781%) and regressed in2reg, overall, and reg2reg timing; equivalence, activity, and replay were not run after the parent-context failure.
